notes: The focused C++ and Java cases check the current publication precondition for timestamped Send Interaction. Each confirms a timestamped send while published returns a valid retraction handle, then requires InteractionClassNotPublished after unpublication and observes no callback attributable to the rejected call. They do not assert post-republication delivery or timestamped ordering; callback absence is only a test-oracle observation.

requirements.statement: The timestamped Send Interaction overload declares InteractionClassNotPublished; after withdrawing the selected interaction-class publication, the tests require that exact exception. A prior published send establishes a valid baseline, and callback absence is checked after the rejected call without claiming post-republication delivery.
